author: Ankit
problem: Read an H by W grid of '.' (empty) and '#' (wall); the top-left square is empty. Starting there and moving only right or down through empty squares, print the maximum number of squares that can be visited, counting the start.
bug_description: `s[i][j] == 0` compares instead of assigning, so an empty square cut off by walls keeps length 1 and the squares after it count as reachable.

comments.accurate: Finds the longest walk from the top-left square moving only right or down through empty squares
comments.wrong_behavior: Each empty square extends the longest open run to its left or above it; walls reset the count to 0
comments.wrong_location: Unreachable squares handled; check the first row and column, which have only one neighbor
